title: MobbyHill
note: Owner pick for this week. MobbyHill is a single file wireframe off road 4x4 game: driver seat camera, phone tilt lean, rollover physics, sand, mud and water, a garage, and four modes (Trail, Fuel, Hill climb, Climb plus fuel) with ghosts and a damage switch. It loads sdk.js from 2026-10-30-orange-scores.vercel.app for leaderboards and the weekly token wallet. That host already allows itch.io and itch.zone origins, and the game keeps working if the script fails to load. Suggested gate: the demo plays Trail mode in full, and buying unlocks Fuel, Hill climb, Climb plus fuel and the garage.
